claim_text: Contemporaneous courthouse reporting states that Said Shafii Farah and Abdiwahab Maalim Aftin were acquitted of all charges against them in the June 7, 2024 Feeding Our Future jury trial in No. 22-CR-124.

supporting_passages.quote: were acquitted of all charges against them

qualifiers: SECONDARY_VERIFIED source quality despite adjudicated legal event
supersede or corroborate with verdict forms, minute entry, judgment, or other primary court record when retrieved
do not infer count-by-count acquittals for the five convicted defendants from this claim
editorial_notes: The USAO-MN June 7 release names only the five convicted defendants and therefore does not independently establish the identities of the two fully acquitted defendants.
